contradictions.explanation: With only three teams and Dara, Cleo, and Yara mutually all on different teams from each other, each would need to occupy one of the three teams alone, which is possible, but combined with Finn and Vik needing placement, but taken alone these three pairwise-different statements combined with only three teams force Dara, Cleo, and Yara to fill all three teams exactly, leaving no team for Finn or Vik, which is inconsistent if everyone must belong to one of the three teams.
